Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://erode.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Erode Counselor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Counselor post is 24th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, Public Health, or Counselling from a recognized university. Alternatively, a PG Diploma in Counselling and Communication is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Counselor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Counselor post is 42 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counselor post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Counselor post in the District Child Protection Unit Erode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Counselor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit and experience. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic qualifications and relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the DCPU Erode Counselor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Does the recruitment require any specific work experience?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have at least 1 year of working experience with the Government or an NGO, preferably in the field of Women & Child Development.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Erode, which is https://erode.nic.in.
